capabilities: Undo the last file or folder deletion by restoring it from the .trash folder
Undo and redo file and folder renames and moves
Cap the undo history length in settings (10-999 entries)
Skip its own restore operations via a timed event-ignore window
disambiguation: Not an editor undo; it only reverses file deletions and moves, not text changes.
extras: Deletion restore requires Obsidian's 'Deleted files' setting to use the vault .trash folder, not the system trash; same-basename entries in .trash collide; history is cleared on reload or disable; a registered debug command ('A1 Debug: Dump all commands') writes commands_dump.txt to the vault root and is marked temporary in source.
problem: Obsidian has no undo for vault operations, so a mistaken file move or deletion must be fixed by hand.
summary: Vault-history plugin that records file and folder deletions and renames so they can be undone and redone from the command palette.
